# @francofantomius/docs-gen

> Modern Material Design 3 static documentation generator from Markdown files, powered by Lit and Vite.

`@francofantomius/docs-gen` compiles directories of Markdown files into an accessible, responsive Material Design 3 Single Page Application (SPA). It features full-text client-side search, 16 Material color palettes with dark/light theme switching, code blocks with copy-to-clipboard buttons, GitHub callout alerts, and an automated GitHub Actions deployment workflow for GitHub Pages.

## Overview
- [Docs Gen Home](#/): Overview of features and core concepts.
- [Getting Started](#/getting-started): Step-by-step quickstart for GitHub Actions and local CLI usage.

## Usage
- [CLI Reference](#/cli): Full guide to `docs-gen dev` and `docs-gen build` commands and flags.
- [GitHub Actions Deployment](#/github-actions): Continuous deployment workflow to GitHub Pages using the reusable composite action.

## Reference
- [Markdown & Frontmatter Syntax](#/markdown-syntax): YAML frontmatter options, alerts (`> [!NOTE]`), tables, code blocks, and custom web components.
- [Configuration (`docs.config.json`)](#/configuration): Centralized project configuration and option precedence.
- [Theming & Color Palettes](#/theming): Light/dark modes, 16 Material 3 color palettes, and search bar keyboard shortcuts.

## Optional
- [Full Documentation Concatenated](llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated documentation in a single file for direct LLM ingestion.
